lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes generally worked, winning 2 out of 3 tests with an average noise-corrected lift of +1.6%.
home, wait_info changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
Evidence remains mixed for finish, new_screen, choose_path, hint, and adoption, redesign, as results were inconsistent across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test completed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Journey Order
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users customize their pet before creating or syncing an account.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (66.0%). Allowing users to create their pet first builds ownership and emotional investment before asking for sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Custom Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet customization and ensure your desktop pet is safely backed up.

candidates.title: Two-Column Adoption Certificate Overview
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet traits on one side and adoption confirmation details on the other.
candidates.why: The adoption step drops to 66.0% conversion with 89s median time. Structured two-column layout clarifies choices and speeds up final confirmation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your new companion's details and confirm adoption to bring them to your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate into a two-column layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Lowest conversion step (66%), redesign has mixed historical results (+2.3% avg across 2 tests) and requires new screen UI.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Setup Checklist Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive checklist on the final intro screen detailing how to summon, minimize, hide, and talk to your desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3 emails) about how to control, hide, or interact with pets after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Ready to Meet Your Companion!
home_intro.body: Here is a quick overview of how to interact, minimize, or talk to your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive setup checklist to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and drop-off, but finish new_screen historically shows modest +0.5% lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive quick quiz flow on path selection to guide undecided users to the best pet creation option.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has an extremely high mean time (514s vs 8s median), showing that struggling users spend significant time stuck on path selection.

choose_path.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion Path
choose_path.body: Answer two quick questions to match with the perfect pet adoption experience.

guard.reason: Adding a quiz sub-flow to choose_path to help users decide is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long mean time on choose_path, but new_flow changes have consistently failed in past tests (-2.6% avg).

candidates.title: Saved Pet Account Protection Headline
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize that signing in prevents pet data loss and restores existing pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing back in. Sign-in copy changes consistently produce strong positive lift (+1.6% average).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Secure & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Creating or signing into your account ensures your pets and customizations are safely saved to the cloud and never lost.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to emphasize account backup and security is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Top support issue (8 emails) combined with sign_in copy changes having high historical success rate (+1.6% avg, config only).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Creation Quality Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Add an explicit guarantee hint and fine-tuning badge during photo upload reassuring users they can adjust their pet appearance anytime.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected, contributing to high drop-off during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Don't worry! You can fine-tune or regenerate your pet's appearance anytime for free.

guard.reason: text in 'upload_photos.hint' talks about price or money

candidates.title: Compact Path Options Layout
candidates.change: Switch path selection to a compact layout that simplifies decision-making and reduces visual clutter.
candidates.why: High mean duration on choose_path (514s) indicates option paralysis or cognitive load for a subset of users.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Choose how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet companion.

guard.reason: Switching choose_path to a compact layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean duration on choose_path, but layout changes have thin evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction & Command Guide Copy
candidates.change: Rewrite home intro text to give explicit instructions on tray icons, right-click context menus, and chat keybindings.
candidates.why: Support theme after_onboarding confusion shows users are unaware of basic desktop pet interaction mechanisms.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet for controls, double-click to chat, or click the tray icon to hide/show anytime.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro copy to explain controls and interaction instructions is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change addressing support issues with post-onboarding interaction clarity.

candidates.title: Sign-In Recovery & Multi-Account Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint guiding returning users to use their original login provider to avoid creating duplicate empty accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report missing pets upon sign-in, which frequently stems from signing into a secondary account.

sign_in.hint: Tip: Use the same email or login provider you used previously to access all your existing pets instantly.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Tray Sound Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and audio sound prompts on the waiting screen when asset building completes.
candidates.why: The home wait step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report uncertainty over whether the desktop pet app opened.

waiting.hint: We will play a quick chime and alert you as soon as your desktop pet is ready to appear.

guard.reason: Adding audio and notification ready prompts to the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s mean), but notification changes showed negative lift in past tests (-1.9%).
